title: Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts: Haul-Away Allowance on Completed Replacements and Allowance Booking
content:
## The allowance

When Bridgewell's network contractor completes a replacement under a Homeowner Service Contract, removing the old equipment is part of the installation, and a haul-away allowance is owed on that service request as soon as the completion report is on file, provided the tier's haul-away allowance is above 0.00 (a tier whose haul-away allowance is 0.00 owes and books none). The allowance is booked once per request with the allowance type haul-away, records the contracted disposal charge as its invoice amount, and counts toward the aggregate limit but not toward any item cap.

| Record on the request | Position |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell replacement with its completion report on file, tier's haul-away allowance above 0.00 (Bridgewell HomeCare Silver, Gold, Platinum) | haul-away allowance owed on that request |
| Bridgewell replacement with its completion report on file, tier's haul-away allowance 0.00 (Bridgewell ApplianceCare, SystemsCare, HomeCare Bronze) | none owed or booked |
| Haul-away allowance already booked on that request | not booked again |
| Allowance amount | counts toward the contract's aggregate limit only |

## Booking an allowance

The tool is `book_supplemental_allowance_cce1a240`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call adds one supplemental allowance of one type to the request's claim-handling history on a homeowner service request that carries a repair or replacement authorization; the amount recorded counts toward the contract's aggregate benefit limit from the day it is recorded and never toward an item cap.

### Parameters

- `homeplan_contract_id` — the homeowner service contract number the request is placed under, as returned by the homeowner contract lookup. Identifier.
- `homeplan_service_request_id` — the service request number the allowance is paid on, as returned by the claim-history lookup. Identifier.
- `allowance_type` — which allowance is paid, one of: `code_violation` (correcting a code violation that must be fixed to complete the covered work), `permit` (permits the covered work requires), `haul_away` (removing and disposing of equipment Bridgewell replaced), `refrigerant` (refrigerant recovery and recharge on covered cooling work), `crane_access` (crane or lift access to rooftop equipment), `slab_access` (opening and closing a concrete slab to reach a covered leak).
- `invoice_amount` — the documented or contracted charge the allowance pays toward. USD, rounded to 2 decimal places, positive.
- `amount` — the allowance payment recorded. USD, rounded to 2 decimal places, positive.

### Return

On success the tool returns `allowance_reference` (the allowance record reference), `homeplan_service_request_id` (the request paid on), `allowance_type` (the type recorded), `invoice_amount` and `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), and `status`, which reads "paid" when recorded. The request then shows the allowance as paid.

### Input-return illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `allowance_type` `haul_away`, `invoice_amount` 42.00 and `amount` 42.00 on a request returns a confirmation carrying the same type and figures, an allowance reference and the status "paid".
